meanings.usage: 指包括父母和孩子的家庭单位
表示待在某处不离开，常与at home连用
不可数名词，指打扫、洗衣等家庭劳动
通常与at连用，at noon表示在中午
与in连用，in the afternoon表示在下午
与in连用，in the evening表示在晚上
不及物动词，后接地点时需用介词in/at
可数名词，read newspaper表示看报纸
可简写为TV，watch television表示看电视
不可数名词，do homework表示做作业
频率副词，表示习惯性动作
频率副词，表示偶尔发生

phrases.usage: 表示居住在某个地点，后接门牌号或地名

examples.en: They live at 87 King Street.

phrases.usage: 去上班，表示去工作地点

examples.en: Mr. Sawyer goes to work every day.
The children go to school in the morning.
Their father takes them to school every day.
examples.zh: 他们的父亲每天送他们去学校。

examples.en: She does the housework at home.
She always eats her lunch at noon.
They often drink tea together.
The children come home from school.
The children always do their homework.
examples.zh: 孩子们总是做家庭作业。

examples.en: Then they go to bed.

phrases.usage: /ˈevri deɪ/ adverb phrase. 每天（表示频率，与一般现在时连用描述日常活动）

grammar.title: 频率副词在一般现在时中的位置
grammar.structure: 主语 + be动词/助动词 + 频率副词 + 行为动词
grammar.definition: 频率副词（always, usually, often, sometimes, never等）用于描述动作发生的频率，在一般现在时的句子中，通常放在行为动词之前，be动词和助动词之后 用于描述习惯性动作或日常活动

examples.en: She always eats her lunch at noon.
He usually reads his newspaper.
Sometimes he watches television.

grammar.title: 时间介词的用法
grammar.structure: in + 较长时段 / at + 特定时刻 / on + 具体日期
grammar.definition: in, at, on都是表示时间概念的介词，但使用规则不同：in用于较长的时间段（上午、下午、晚上、月份、年份、季节），at用于具体的时刻或短的时间段（中午、夜间），on用于具体日期或星期 正确使用时间介词是英语表达的基础

examples.en: In the morning, Mr. Sawyer goes to work.
She eats lunch at noon.
In the afternoon, she sees her friends.
At night, the children do homework.

grammar.title: 一般现在时描述日常活动
grammar.structure: 主语 + 动词原形/动词第三人称单数 + 其他
grammar.definition: 一般现在时用于描述经常发生的动作、习惯或客观事实。当主语是第三人称单数时，动词需要加-s或-es 描述家庭成员的日常作息规律

examples.en: Mr. Sawyer goes to work.
The children go to school.
Mrs. Sawyer stays at home.

patterns.pattern: 主语 + goes to + 地点

imitations.en: He goes to the office every day.

original.en: Mrs. Sawyer stays at home every day.
original.zh: 索耶太太每天都待在家里。

imitations.en: He stays at home on weekends.
The old man stays at home alone.
imitations.zh: 那位老人独自待在家里。

imitations.en: She does the cooking every day.

patterns.pattern: In the + 时间段, 主语 + 动词

original.en: In the evening, the children come home.

imitations.en: In the morning, I drink coffee.
In the afternoon, she visits her friends.

lines.en: The Sawyers live at 87 King Street.
In the morning, Mr Sawyer goes to work and the children go to school.
Their father takes them to school every day.
Mrs Sawyer stays at home every day.
She always eats her lunch at noon.
In the afternoon, she usually sees her friends.
In the evening, the children come home from school.
Mr Sawyer comes home from work.
At night, the children always do their homework.
Mr Sawyer usually reads his newspaper, but sometimes he and his wife watch television.

lead.summary: 索耶一家住在国王街87号。 早上，索耶先生去上班，孩子们去上学。语法聚焦：go to work, 上班。、stay at home, 呆在家里。、do the housework, 料理家务。。
lead.tips: 语法重点：go to work, 上班。；stay at home, 呆在家里。；do the housework, 料理家务。。重点词汇：live、stay、home 等，结合课文例句记忆。练法：先盲听跟读，再对照参考译文理解，最后尝试复述课文。
lead.question: When do the children do their homework? 孩子们什么时候做功课？

translation:
索耶一家住在国王街87号。
早上，索耶先生去上班，孩子们去上学。父亲每天送孩子们去上学。
索耶夫人每天呆在家里。她料理家务。
她总是在正午吃午饭。
下午，她总是会见她的朋友。她们经常在一起喝茶。
傍晚，孩子们放学回家。他们到家很早。
索耶先生下班回家。他到家很晚。
晚上，孩子们总是做作业，然后去睡觉。索耶先生总是读报纸，但有时和他的妻子一起看电视。
